vm_tools: Add D-Bus and gRPC service to cicerone This is a refactoring of concierge into cicerone. The first patch set uploaded is exact copies of container_listener_impl.*, service.* and virtual_machine* from concierge. This should make this much easier to review since the vast majority of these changes are either removals or copies from concierge. The additional D-Bus service functionality needed in cicerone that concierge uses for communication is also included here. This CL also disables starting of the container_listener service inside of cicerone, yet leaves all that functionality there. This is to keep the delta from concierge to a minimum. The next CL will remove all of the corresponding pieces from concierge (one of which is a full removal of container_listener) and in that CL I will turn on container_listener in cicerone so we don't have a port conflict. BUG=chromium:842845 TEST=Verified with full set of code that this works on eve CQ-DEPEND=CL:1069767 Change-Id: I5fc335b58181cc055b9279b3eb52085428a19894 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1070871 Commit-Ready: Jeffrey Kardatzke <jkardatzke@google.com> Tested-by: Jeffrey Kardatzke <jkardatzke@google.com> Reviewed-by: Stephen Barber <smbarber@chromium.org>

rsa: Optimization of multiplications for Cortex-M0 We multiply 2 32-bit numbers (and not 64-bit numbers), and then add another 32-bit number, which makes it possible to optimize the assembly and save a few instructions. With -O3, 3072-bit exponent, lower verification time from 122 ms to 104 ms on STM32F072 @48Mhz. Optimized mac function from Dmitry Grinberg <dmitrygr@google.com>. BRANCH=poppy BUG=b:35647963 BUG=b:77608104 TEST=On staff, flash, verification successful TEST=make test-rsa, make test-rsa3 TEST=Flash test-utils and test-rsa to hammer => pass Change-Id: I584c54c631a3f59f691849a279b308e8d4b4b22d Signed-off-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/449024 Reviewed-by: Vincent Palatin <vpalatin@chromium.org>
